        Presents     The Speakeasy

We’ve grown beyond our beloved Bar & Grill in Rochester, NY, and are thrilled to welcome you to our latest adventure – The Speakeasy,

Come experience our unique flair themed restaurant amazing food, craft cocktails along with great entertainment weekly!

 About WafflesRWild.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 From The Owners
Waffles R Wild was created by Owner, Danielle, and her father, Michael.
What started as a dream and an idea became a reality in January 2018. Piece by piece the truck was built from the ground up. Michael’s construction knowledge and Danielle’s Background in culinary and restaurant management made it possible for the truck to be running in less than six months. Now their dream has come true and they are proudly serving their creations to the world.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
  Waffles R Wild was created by Owner, Danielle, and her parents, Roxanne and Michael. What started as a dream and an idea became a reality in January 2018. Piece by piece the truck was built from the ground up. Michael’s construction knowledge and Danielle’s Background in culinary and restaurant management made it possible for the truck to be running in less than six months. Now their dream has come true and they are proudly serving their creations to the world.
Danielle is a 2014 Greece Olympia grad who studied culinary arts at Monroe Community College. Two years ago, she and her dad built a food truck to start Waffles R Wild. It did so well she decided to open a brick and mortar location too.
“I worked in restaurants since I was 15 years old and I am really into food. I love the industry. So, after college, I was ready to move onto my next thing and I figured why not do it for myself,” said Duemmel.
There are all kinds of waffle options from waffle sandwiches to buttermilk hand-breaded fried chicken, waffle pizzas and desserts. 
“I absolutely love waffles,” Duemmel said. “I have to, don’t I?”
“I love working with my family first of all and second of all, I am very proud of my daughter of course. We just love it. We love the food truck and we meet a lot of people out there, new businesses, they’ve been awesome, supportive,” said Roxanne Duemmel, Danielle’s mother.
